title: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services, full FT-900 report (August 2026 data)
source: EST: the FT-900 release itself, CB 26-142 / BEA 26-40 ("U.S. INTERNATIONAL TRADE IN GOODS AND SERVICES, JULY 2026", released 08:30 ET 2026-09-03), whose page-1 summary box reads verbatim 'Next release: Tuesday, October 6, 2026' — PDF fetched direct 2026-09-05 from census.gov/foreign-trade/Press-Release/current_press_release/ft900.pdf and its text layer extracted locally. Independently corroborated by the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx (fetched direct 2026-09-05), whose 2026-10-06 10:00 row reads 'International trade (Full report)**'. Two primaries, and still filed estimate on two counts: this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and no `confirmed` prefix above covers a joint Census/BEA release (`CENSUS:` and `BEA:` each cover one publisher's own schedule page, not a co-published release's own next-release line). The 10:00 ET time is the Atlanta Fed's posting slot for the GDPNow update, NOT the release time — the FT-900 releases at 08:30 ET
notes: THE ATTRIBUTION HALF OF advance-economic-indicators-2026-09-30, and the reason that event's ledger says 'the number lands 09-30, the meaning lands 10-06.' Measured this session from 1,822 GDPNow vintage deltas (2014-05-01 to 2026-07-28, ContribArchives): the advance report carries essentially all of the trade information — median |change in net exports| 0.265pp on the 81 AEIR vintages against 0.062pp on the 129 full-report vintages, and across 45 AEIR-then-full-report pairs the follow-up move is a median 0.28x the advance move with a 51% sign agreement, i.e. a coin flip on direction and a quarter of the size. What the full report adds is the end-use split the advance report does not carry, and for a book long AI hardware that split IS the read: July's capital-goods imports rose $14.4B m/m and this release named the whole rise line by line — computers +$6.9B, computer accessories +$6.6B, semiconductors +$1.2B. Impact `low` is deliberate and is about MARKET impact, not information value: the release is a 4x-smaller nowcast mover than the advance, `symbols: []`, and no house playbook is macro-keyed. Discovered during the advance-economic-indicators-2026-09-30 initial research (2026-09-05).
